title: Curriculum Vitae or Resume Format 1
format:

  pdf:
    colorlinks: false
    mainfont: Open Sans
    include-in-header:
      text: |
        \usepackage[lmargin = 0.7in,rmargin = 0.7in,
        tmargin =0.9in, bmargin = 0.9in]{geometry}
        \usepackage{fancyhdr}
        \pagestyle{fancy}
        
        \fancyhf{}
        \rhead{\thepage}
        \lhead{Name Name}
        
        \makeatletter         
        \renewcommand\maketitle{
        \begin{center}
        {\Large \textbf{Name Name}}\\
        \vspace{1mm}
        \normalsize email\\
        \vspace{1mm}
        Updated Month YYYY
        \end{center}} 
        \makeatother
     
        \addtokomafont{disposition}{\rmfamily}
format-links: [pdf]
---
